display_name: gdn conv mtp bf16 state fp32
description:
GDN decode/MTP from projected BF16 QKV through causal four-tap convolution, SiLU, normalized recurrence and gated RMSNorm. Preserves the rolling convolution history, caller output and all indexed FP32 recurrent checkpoints, including accepted-token and null-request behavior. D=128; TP and head-ratio configurations remain correlated as defined by the complete shape catalog.

Production entry: QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention._forward_core_decode_spec_fused_norm; fixed source revision source-package-sha256:7f0c3eb8ba95d5fba4ba05749173997816b086ad745712164ab3adce4e8106e4.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Pool capacity is independent of active requests; reserve slot 0 and distinct destination/checkpoint slots. Inactive requests and arbitrary slot padding remain supported. Q/K heads=16/TP; value/state heads=16*head_ratio/TP; state per slot is [value_heads,128,128]. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: State matrices retain [Hv,128,128] and production strides, offsets and shared backing. Normal carried states now come from 32 previous valid tokens with fixed layer A_log/bias and the declared GDN per-head or KDA per-channel decay recurrence, FP32 between stores and actual state dtype at checkpoints. Synthetic raw projections have channel/head gains and AR(1) coefficient .5. Conv history and the current request are contiguous windows of that same process; candidate checkpoint j and convolution accepted-prefix shift refer to the same past endpoint. This is generated history, not captured model data. Existing tiny/zero/saturation/cancellation cases retain their stress construction. Pool capacity and physical slot pattern are independent input parameters, not inferred from request count or candidate width. Slot0/null semantics and unused storage guards remain.

Numerical contract reference-materialization-v1-20261013: Convolution products and accumulation use FP32 on stored inputs; SiLU output is stored to mixed_qkv in BF16 before GDN reads it. GDN recurrence and fused output normalization use FP32, with state/checkpoint and final output cast at declared storage boundaries. Native BF16 multiply before FP32 accumulation is an implementation precision loss, not an extra reference quantizer. Independent FP32 between specified storage/QDQ boundaries; TF32 disabled. Unchanged upstream torch.allclose(reference_float, candidate_float, atol=0.01, rtol=0.05). Prior version: evidence/reference-revision-20261013/before.tar.gz. Source and causal evidence: docs/production-bench-v3/CORE_NUMERICAL_ATTRIBUTION_20261013.md.

Current baseline: patched_native; install dependencies/native-fixes/apply.py after the pinned production dependencies. Original native failures are retained; this repair has no new performance baseline.

defined_outputs.outputs_and_state: Native conv updates cache slot indices[n,0], prefix length query_len+2, shifting history from accepted-1. mixed_qkv is scratch (active conv rows may change); gate/backing must remain untouched. GDN writes all positive checkpoint destinations and returns caller out.
